components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 18px;border:1px solid var(--ink,#111);background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#111);font:600 .9375rem "Archivo",system-ui,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:background .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-btn:hover{background:var(--accent,#1E6B4F);border-color:var(--accent,#1E6B4F);color:var(--accent-ink,#F2F1EC)}.ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1E6B4F);outline-offset:3px}

components.css: .ds-row{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:3rem minmax(0,1fr) 7rem 2rem;gap:0 20px;align-items:baseline;padding:24px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#D3D0C7);font-family:"Archivo",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#111);transition:background .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-n,.ds-meta{font:500 .875rem "JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;color:var(--muted,#5E5E5A);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-row h3{margin:0;font-weight:700;font-variation-settings:"wdth" 110;font-size:1.5rem;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.15}.ds-row h3 a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-row h3 a::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0}.ds-row h3 a:focus-visible{outline:none}.ds-row h3 span{background:linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor) 0 100%/0 2px no-repeat;transition:background-size .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-d{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--muted,#5E5E5A)}.ds-go{justify-self:end;color:var(--muted,#5E5E5A);transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color .3s}.ds-row:hover,.ds-row:focus-within{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#1E6B4F) 7%,transparent)}.ds-row:hover h3 span,.ds-row:focus-within h3 span{background-size:100% 2px}.ds-row:hover .ds-go,.ds-row:focus-within .ds-go{transform:translate(4px,-4px);color:var(--accent,#1E6B4F)}.ds-row:has(a:focus-visible){outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1E6B4F);outline-offset:-2px}

components.name: Sync Indicator
components.description: Mono status line with a pulsing Ledger Green dot.
components.css: .ds-sync{margin:0;font:400 .8125rem "JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;color:var(--muted,#5E5E5A);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.ds-sync::before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent,#1E6B4F);animation:ds-pulse 2.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) infinite}@keyframes ds-pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#1E6B4F) 55%,transparent)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px transparent}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-sync::before{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
The site reads as one printed sheet of technical paper. A single warm paper ground carries everything; structure comes from lines, never from coloured bands or boxed cards. Two fixed hairlines frame the content column like page margins, full-bleed rules cross that frame so it reads as a grid, and each section is laid out as a ledger entry: heading column, vertical hairline, content.

Density is calm and editorial. Archivo, pushed wide through its `wdth` axis, carries every word; JetBrains Mono appears only where the content is data (table headers, row numbers, languages, dates, field labels). Colour is almost absent: ink on paper, plus one ink-green that marks state and nothing else. The only object that lifts off the page is the profile sheet, a lighter slip of paper with a soft shadow.

The world exists in light and dark, following the system preference, with every token swapped as a pair. A faint paper grain sits over everything and never intercepts input.
keyCharacteristics: One paper ground; no section backgrounds, no cards.
Structure from 1px hairlines, 3px ink bars and a closing double rule.
Wide Archivo for all text; mono strictly for data.
One accent (ledger green) reserved for state, focus and the sync dot.
Square corners everywhere; circles only for small status dots.
A single lifted object: the profile sheet.

rules.name: The State-Only Green Rule
rules.body: Ledger Green appears only in response to state (hover, focus, selection, "in progress", live sync). At rest, a screen is ink and paper.

rules.name: The Paired Token Rule
rules.body: Every colour exists as a light/dark pair under `prefers-color-scheme`; a new colour without its dark twin is not part of the system.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is used only for values a ledger would tabulate: column headers, row numbers, languages, dates, topics, sheet field labels, the sync line. Never for headings, prose or buttons.

rules.name: The Wide Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings widen through the `wdth` axis (110-112) and tighten tracking (-0.02 to -0.03em); body stays at width 100.

rules.name: The One Lifted Sheet Rule
rules.body: Only the profile sheet casts a shadow. Everything else lies on the page and is separated by rules.

rules.name: The Line Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy of separation is 1px hairline (rows, sections) < 1px ink (emphasis, the hero rule, table header bottom) < 3px ink (heading bars, table top) < 4px double ink (closes the document before contact).

dos: Do separate content with rules from the line weight ladder (1px hairline, 1px ink, 3px ink, 4px double) instead of backgrounds or boxes.
Do keep a screen ink and paper at rest; bring in Ledger Green only for hover, focus, selection, in-progress status and live sync.
Do set every heading in Archivo widened (wdth 110-112) with negative tracking, and lead section headings with the 28px x 3px ink bar.
Do use JetBrains Mono for tabular data only, with tabular numerals for numbers and dates.
Do keep corners square on every rectangle; reserve circles for status dots.
Do define every new colour as a light/dark pair.
Do use the house ease (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for transitions and entrances, and honour reduced motion by removing all animation and transition.
donts: Don't add section background bands, cards or tinted panels; the page has one ground.
Don't add shadows to anything except the profile sheet.
Don't introduce a second accent hue; the only non-palette colours are GitHub language dots at dot size.
Don't round button, tag or container corners.
Don't set prose, headings or buttons in mono.
